mostWorthwhile.text: Applying causation to the sun-warmed stone was most worthwhile: it gave Kant’s abstract claim a concrete example while distinguishing a causal concept from an empirical finding.

leastWorthwhile.text: The first combination was clear but predictable, and as the only offered action required little decision-making.

surprise.text: Kant’s response was presented as the mind structuring experience, not as an experimental refutation of Hume.

continue.text: I would continue, cautiously: the distinction between evidence, certainty and causal judgment is interesting, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
